owner_confirmed_infrastructure.typical_water_depth_context: approximately 3 ft or less at pier end; tide dependent

objective: Measure local near-bottom hypoxia/stratification state unattended with enough temporal resolution and metadata to support Jubilee forecasting and matched-control calibration.

phase_1_architecture.controller: ESP32-S3 class Wi-Fi microcontroller in a weather-resistant pier enclosure
phase_1_architecture.telemetry: join existing pier Wi-Fi, auto-reconnect, HTTPS/MQTT-style push to canonical Jubilee ingestion endpoint
phase_1_architecture.local_buffer: required; preserve observations through Wi-Fi outages and backfill without changing observed_at
phase_1_architecture.sensor_class: low-cost modular galvanic DO plus conductivity/salinity plus temperature; electrically isolate DO and conductivity electronics
phase_1_architecture.do_note: Atlas Scientific low-cost DO is galvanic, not optical. Do not describe it as optical DO. Optical DO remains preferred scientifically if a reliable sub-$1k alternative is later found.
phase_1_architecture.depth_sensor: defer pressure/depth if necessary to remain below budget; use NOAA/local water level plus measured fixed sensor elevation as interim context
phase_1_architecture.unattended_rule: No model workflow may depend on owner manual predawn sampling.

deployment_geometry.phase_1_recommended: one near-bottom package at pier end approximately 0.15-0.30 m above sediment and below ordinary low-water level
deployment_geometry.phase_2_preferred: add a second near-surface package only after bottom package proves stable and valuable
deployment_geometry.bottom_clearance: record exact height above sediment; avoid burial, prop wash, piling stagnation and direct sediment contact
deployment_geometry.reference: record fixed sensor elevation relative to pier reference and pair with water-level observations

sampling.high_risk_mode: 1-2 minute sampling may be enabled automatically during selected high-risk predawn windows if supported
sampling.clock: UTC internally; render Central Time separately

power_and_telemetry.preferred: shore-powered low-voltage controller with local flash or microSD buffering and existing pier Wi-Fi
power_and_telemetry.outage_policy: continue logging locally; upload backlog when connectivity returns
power_and_telemetry.security: store Wi-Fi credentials using device secure storage where available; never commit credentials to repository
power_and_telemetry.marine_environment: GFCI shore power, low-voltage submerged hardware only, weatherproof enclosure, marine cable glands, strain relief and surge protection

predeployment: zero-DO calibration because <1 mg/L accuracy matters
ongoing: cross-check against tide and regional sources
quality_control.maintenance_model_rule: flag service/calibration windows and do not treat before/after maintenance jumps as environmental features

reference_prices_checked_2026_09_07.role: galvanic DO probe, EZO DO circuit, isolated carrier

reference_prices_checked_2026_09_07.item: Atlas Surveyor Analog Temperature Kit or equivalent

candidate_sub_1000_bom.budget_note: Leaves roughly $160 for mounting, calibration consumables, cable management and power conditioning. Verify electrical/interface compatibility before purchase because the bare-bones Wi-Fi carrier is sold for EZO circuits and the exact DO/EC kit contents overlap carrier hardware.
candidate_sub_1000_bom.cost_optimization: Prefer purchasing individual EZO circuits/probes where duplicate isolated carrier boards would otherwise be bought. Target final BOM below $900 before miscellaneous marine hardware.

model_guardrails: No positive production weight until provenance/QC pass and held-out incremental value is demonstrated.
Near-bottom measurements are DIRECT only for 437/Montrose immediate vicinity.
Preserve fouling, service, calibration and telemetry-missingness metadata.
No manual field check is required for routine operation or label generation.
